name: Cabernet Cranberry Sauce
description: Cranberry sauce simmered in Cabernet Sauvignon with tangerine and cinnamon. Keeps in the fridge up to 2 months and freezes well.

recipeInstructions.name: Boil sugar and wine
recipeInstructions.text: Bring 1 1/4 cups sugar and 1 cup Cabernet Sauvignon to a boil in a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.

recipeInstructions.name: Add cranberries
recipeInstructions.text: Add 1 (12-ounce) package fresh cranberries, 2 teaspoons grated tangerine rind, and 1 (3-inch) cinnamon stick, and return to a boil, stirring constantly.

recipeInstructions.name: Simmer
recipeInstructions.text: Reduce heat and simmer, partially covered, 10 to 15 minutes or until cranberry skins pop.

recipeInstructions.name: Finish
recipeInstructions.text: Remove and discard cinnamon stick. Cool slightly; serve warm, or chill 2 hours if desired.
Sauce may be stored in the refrigerator up to 2 months. Also freezes well.
